interface: Claude Code CLI 2.1.317 headless (claude -p), skill installed in a fresh project folder
python: 3.12.13 venv with the skill's requirements.txt (OCR on)

recipe.project_folder: a new empty folder per sheet holding <sheet>.pdf and .claude/skills/pid-to-kg (a copy of the skill at the commit)
recipe.prompt:
Convert `<sheet>.pdf` into a knowledge graph. The P&ID is on page 1.

This is a non-interactive run: nobody can answer questions, so make the choice you would recommend and note it in your final report. Python 3.12 with the skill's packages is already installed and on PATH; run every script as `python -I <full path to the script>`, and do not install anything.
recipe.cli: claude -p PROMPT --model 'claude-opus-5-5[1m]' --max-turns 150 --setting-sources project --strict-mcp-config --permission-mode default --tools Read Write Edit Glob Grep Bash Skill --allowedTools Read Write Edit Glob Grep Skill 'Bash(python -I:*)' 'Bash(ls:*)' --output-format stream-json --verbose
recipe.inputs: OPEN100 and TE PNGs saved as one-page PDFs at a declared 300 dpi (Pillow); Pahala pages 21 and 22 copied out of the public PDF
recipe.concurrency: run 1: up to four sheets at once; replicates and ablations: up to eight at once, 2026-11-11

voided.why: A first launch of the 46 ablation runs wrote the variant names with a trailing carriage return (Windows line endings in the lane lists); the Read tool could not open files under those folder names, so many runs copied their pages to scratch folders and read them there, which changes how they read tiles. No run read another run's files. All 46 were set aside unscored and re-run under clean names; the harness now refuses a name with a control character.

variants.r1-r3: replicates, identical recipe, a fresh project folder per run
variants.noocr: the skill's requirements without rapidocr-onnxruntime (a second venv; numpy is then absent too, so blank-tile detection uses the skill's histogram fallback): no OCR hints, no OCR orientation or text-size render choice; text-layer hints remain on PDFs that have one
variants.noqa: prompt adds: Skip the QA loop (step 7 of the checklist): run build_kg.py once, do not re-check or fix any warning, and go straight to the report.
variants.2x2: prompt adds: When you render the pages, run render_pages.py with the options `--long-edge 5000 --tile 3000 --overlap 900` (a 2x2 tile grid); otherwise follow the skill as written.
